title: The Sindhias
definition: The Sindhias were a prominent Maratha dynasty of the Kunbi caste that established a powerful princely state centered in Gwalior, playing a decisive role in 18th-century Indian geopolitics.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the transition from Maratha Confederacy to British Paramountcy, the Anglo-Maratha Wars, and the evolution of the Subsidiary Alliance system.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Sindhias.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
